claim: The dataset contains no predictive signal: performance_rating is statistically independent of all predictor columns.
details: Confirmed by four independent methods: (1) zero Bonferroni-surviving correlations, (2) OLS R² indistinguishable from null permutation distribution (p = 0.46), (3) negative cross-validated RF R², (4) chi-squared independence of salary_band and remote_pct.

claim: All columns are mutually independent — the dataset was generated from independent random distributions.
details: VIF values near 1.0 for all predictors, PCA variance ratios near uniform (1/8), no salary_band group differences in any feature, and chi-squared independence between salary_band and remote_pct.

claim: commute_minutes is the only column with notable distributional anomaly (right-skew and outliers).
details: Skewness = 1.77, 6.1% outliers beyond the IQR upper fence. All other numeric columns have |skewness| < 0.25 and kurtosis consistent with symmetric distributions.

claim: salary_band is randomly assigned with no relation to any other variable.
details: Kruskal-Wallis tests across 8 numeric features all non-significant after Bonferroni correction. Chi-squared test of salary_band vs remote_pct: p = 0.978.

claim: Any predictive model on this dataset will perform no better than predicting the mean.
details: OLS adjusted R² = -0.0002. RF 5-fold CV R² = -0.086. Both are at or below zero, meaning the models do not outperform a constant-mean baseline.
